conceptZh: 積木小隊先蓋出一個歪歪的屋頂，發現不對，聳聳肩一翻就變成「今」。
object: a squad of interlocking building bricks
morph: bricks proudly assemble a wrong flat roof, notice, and flip one piece to complete 今
creativeAngle: 先錯後對，今天的太陽用積木升起來。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale sunshine yellow background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 今 as the only text on screen, drawn in bright cobalt blue solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a squad of red, blue and green bricks with tiny painted faces marches in a line and stacks itself into a lopsided triangle roof; the first 今 is spoken as the roof bricks click on top. 1.7-3.4s: proudly they add a flat bar beneath, but it is the wrong way, a box that looks like a hat; the bricks freeze, glance at each other, and shrug; the second 今 is spoken as one brick pops out and the bar slides into the right 人-plus-short-stroke shape under the roof. 3.4-5s: 今天 is spoken as a tiny yellow brick sun rises over the glyph on a spring, with the little bricks cheering and bouncing. 5-8s: hold; the glyph stays still while one brick does a small spin and a happy wobble well clear of the strokes. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "今、今、今天" (ㄐㄧㄣ、ㄐㄧㄣ、ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄧㄢ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 今 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
